data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root kir, 'to scatter, strew' — kiraṇa, 'a ray of light'. Its root is Sanskrit kir (किर्). A classical Sanskrit term for a ray of light. Kiran is a Sanskrit name meaning “Ray of light; beam”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kiran total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

vedic_reference.note: The name Kiran is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kirana’ which means ‘rays of light’, ‘radiance’, or ‘glow’. In Hindu mythology, Kirana is also the name of a celestial being who personifies the rays of the sun. The name is often given to babies born during the time of the morning sun or during the period of sunrise.
